claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.cast_spell_by_id
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item needs random-table branches that cast existing spells immediately as part of the same activation, rather than granting future spell access.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You cast a spell originating from the chosen point.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: branch-local chosen-origin and nearest-to-origin targeting
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Several outcomes target or anchor effects relative to the point chosen for the wand activation, including nearest-creature selection.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature closest to the chosen point of origin...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item-cast origin/range override on immediate spell casts
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The wand changes where the spell originates and can widen a spell's maximum range to 120 feet when cast from the item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If a spell's maximum range is normally less than 120 feet, it becomes 120 feet when cast from the wand.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: obscured_area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Two branches create temporary areas that are mechanically Lightly Obscured or Heavily Obscured, and the current v4 surface has no atom for that area-state effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: During that time, the area of effect is Lightly Obscured.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: random-table creature-spawn payload for magic-item activations
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: One branch spawns an uncontrolled creature chosen by a nested random roll, but creature-spawn payloads only exist as top-level spell families today.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A magically formed creature appears in an unoccupied space as close to the chosen point of origin as possible.
